requirement: Create a new private repository with no public fork relationship.
acceptance: Repository visibility tests confirm access is restricted to approved organisation members.

requirement: Retain the OpenWA MIT licence and original notices.
acceptance: Licence and NOTICE/UPSTREAM files are present in every release artefact.

requirement: Record the exact imported upstream URL, commit SHA and import date.
acceptance: UPSTREAM.md and build metadata identify the baseline.
notes: Exact OpenWA source commit has not yet been imported.

requirement: Configure upstream as read-only reference only.
acceptance: No automated push or merge path exists from upstream.

requirement: Fetch upstream changes into an isolated review branch.
acceptance: Changes cannot reach main without internal pull request and required checks.

requirement: Disable or restrict private repository forking.
acceptance: Organisation and repository policy evidence exists.

requirement: Protect main and release branches.
acceptance: Direct push, force push and unreviewed merge are blocked.

requirement: Require code-owner approval for gateway, security, database and infrastructure changes.
acceptance: A test pull request demonstrates enforcement.

requirement: Pin dependencies and container images.
acceptance: Lockfiles and immutable image references are committed.
notes: Images are version-tagged but not yet digest-pinned; Node lockfiles remain pending.

requirement: Generate a software bill of materials for releases.
acceptance: Release pipeline produces and retains an SBOM.

requirement: Scan source, dependencies, secrets and images.
acceptance: CI fails for configured critical findings unless an approved exception exists.

requirement: Do not automatically deploy upstream or dependency updates.
acceptance: All updates require review, tests and staging approval.

requirement: Expose a versioned internal provider API independent of the OpenWA public API.
acceptance: Contract tests pass against the provider interface.

requirement: Require an idempotency key for every delivery command.
acceptance: Duplicate command returns the original outcome and does not perform another send.
notes: Current idempotency store is not durable.

requirement: Own each live session on exactly one worker node.
acceptance: Lease/ownership tests prevent concurrent activation.

requirement: Persist session state on an encrypted worker volume.
acceptance: Restart test restores authorised sessions without re-pairing where provider permits.

requirement: Report heartbeat, build version, capacity, queue depth and resource health.
acceptance: Control plane marks stale worker unavailable within configured threshold.

requirement: Report session connection, authentication, last-success and failure state.
acceptance: Operations dashboard reflects forced disconnects and reconnections.

requirement: Accept work only for sessions currently leased to the worker.
acceptance: Cross-node assignment is rejected and audited.

requirement: Use a bounded per-session pipeline and configurable in-flight limit.
acceptance: Load test proves the configured bound is enforced.
notes: Generic worker concurrency is bounded; per-OpenWA-session integration is pending.

requirement: Support graceful drain before deployment or maintenance.
acceptance: No new jobs accepted; active jobs reach a recorded outcome.

requirement: Return provider message identifiers and raw provider status metadata where safe.
acceptance: Delivery attempt record stores the identifier and redacted metadata.

requirement: Forward inbound messages and delivery/read events through signed callbacks or a trusted event channel.
acceptance: Forged and replayed events are rejected.

requirement: Never store full campaign audience lists locally.
acceptance: Worker storage review confirms only bounded active-job data and session state.

requirement: Use object references for media and enforce size/type limits.
acceptance: Large media campaign does not hold the entire batch in memory.

requirement: Sanitise logs and exclude raw MSISDN, message content and credentials by default.
acceptance: Automated log-content tests pass.

requirement: Support safe shutdown and uncertain-state reporting.
acceptance: Kill-during-send test produces an UNKNOWN state rather than automatic duplicate resend.

requirement: Expose engine capability and version.
acceptance: Control plane can block an incompatible campaign/message type.

requirement: Support per-session stable proxy configuration where legitimately required.
acceptance: Configuration change is audited and connectivity tested.

requirement: Do not implement rapid IP rotation or enforcement-evasion behaviour.
acceptance: Security review confirms prohibited capabilities are absent.

requirement: Permit access only to provisioned internal users.
acceptance: Unprovisioned identities cannot authenticate.

requirement: Support mandatory multi-factor authentication.
acceptance: Login without the second factor is rejected.

requirement: Support configurable passwordless/SSO integration later without replacing domain authorisation.
acceptance: Identity provider can be swapped through configuration.

requirement: Implement role-based access control with granular permissions.
acceptance: Permission matrix tests cover every protected action.

requirement: Support users holding multiple roles with least-privilege union of permissions.
acceptance: Effective permissions are displayed and tested.

requirement: Enforce maker-checker separation for campaign release.
acceptance: Campaign creator cannot perform final release when policy requires separation.

requirement: Require step-up authentication for exports, key changes, emergency overrides and destructive actions.
acceptance: Protected action prompts for fresh authentication.
notes: Final campaign approval uses recent MFA; export and emergency workflows are not yet built.

requirement: Enforce configurable idle and absolute session expiry.
acceptance: Expired sessions cannot call APIs.

requirement: Provide account disable, lock and credential reset.
acceptance: Disabled account loses access immediately.

requirement: Detect repeated failed login attempts and apply configurable controls.
acceptance: Threshold alert/lock is produced.

requirement: Record authentication, authorisation failure and privileged-action events.
acceptance: Audit search returns complete events with actor and time.

requirement: Display the user’s last successful login and active sessions.
acceptance: User/admin can identify unexpected access.

requirement: Allow authorised administrators to revoke all sessions for a user.
acceptance: Revoked tokens fail immediately or within configured maximum.

requirement: Prevent shared generic accounts.
acceptance: All production activity maps to a unique human or service identity.

requirement: Use separate scoped service identities for each internal service.
acceptance: Credential review shows no shared superuser secret.

requirement: Support IP allowlisting or VPN-only access as a configurable deployment control.
acceptance: Requests outside allowed network are denied when enabled.
notes: Optional CIDR allowlisting supports trusted-proxy-aware client resolution and records network denials.

requirement: Create internal organisation records without creating external portal users.
acceptance: Organisation can be used on campaigns without login credentials.
notes: Internal organisation creation, retrieval, listing and persistent runtime composition are implemented without external portal identities.

requirement: Store legal/trading name, country, registration reference, industry and status.
acceptance: Required-field validation is enforced.

requirement: Store one or more internal and external contacts with role and communication details.
acceptance: Multiple contacts can be active/effective-dated.

requirement: Record controller, processor or joint-controller role where known.
acceptance: Campaign consent checks can reference the role.

requirement: Record organisation-level restrictions and prohibited purposes.
acceptance: Ineligible campaign purpose is blocked.
notes: Organisation-specific allowed and prohibited campaign purposes are governed through versioned maker-checker policy records and enforced during campaign creation.

requirement: Support active, suspended, under-review and closed status.
acceptance: Suspended organisation cannot launch a campaign.

requirement: Record commercial references such as quote, invoice and payment status.
acceptance: Campaign release policy can require commercial approval.
notes: Versioned campaign commercial records now capture quotation, invoice, currency, recipient volume, pricing, payment reference and payment timestamp with maker-checker approval and revocation.

requirement: Retain an audit history of organisation changes.
acceptance: Historical values and actor are retrievable.
notes: Material profile and lifecycle changes create immutable versioned organisation events with actor, reason and before/after status evidence.

requirement: Prevent accidental duplicate organisation creation.
acceptance: Potential duplicate warning appears based on configured identifiers.
notes: Active organisations are protected by a normalised legal-name and country uniqueness rule in both memory and PostgreSQL repositories.

requirement: Support organisation-specific data-retention and report branding settings.
acceptance: Generated report uses approved configuration version.
notes: Effective-dated organisation policy versions govern contact/campaign retention periods and report branding metadata. The same policy aggregate now carries governed purpose/channel frequency caps.

requirement: Create a consent review at organisation, source or campaign scope.
acceptance: Reviewer selects the scope and system enforces it.

requirement: Record consent collection method, source system, URL/form identifier and date range.
acceptance: Review cannot be approved without required provenance.

requirement: Record the consent wording or an immutable reference and wording version.
acceptance: Approved review identifies exact wording/version.

requirement: Record permitted organisation/controller, purpose, channel and partner use.
acceptance: Campaign outside scope is ineligible.

requirement: Record evidence files or external references with checksums.
acceptance: Evidence tampering can be detected.

requirement: Malware-scan uploaded evidence before availability.
acceptance: Infected/quarantined files cannot be opened or approved.

requirement: Record reviewer, decision, date, expiry and restrictions.
acceptance: Every approval is attributable and time bounded where required.

requirement: Support approved, approved-with-restrictions, rejected, expired and revoked states.
acceptance: State transitions follow policy and are audited.

requirement: Require a reason for rejection, revocation or restriction.
acceptance: Blank reason is blocked.

requirement: Support sample-record review notes without storing unnecessary sample PII.
acceptance: Review can be completed using minimised evidence.

requirement: Require re-review when consent wording, collection method, controller, purpose or source materially changes.
acceptance: Changed version invalidates automatic reuse.

requirement: Link every campaign to a valid consent review or documented non-consent lawful basis where separately approved.
acceptance: Campaign cannot reach release without eligibility reference.

requirement: Expose review expiry warnings and block expired approvals.
acceptance: Expiry alert and release block are verified.

requirement: Allow authorised compliance override only with reason, expiry and second approval.
acceptance: Override is time-bounded and prominently audited.

requirement: Maintain one canonical contact for each normalised MSISDN within the configured identity scope.
acceptance: Duplicate import resolves to existing contact.

requirement: Normalise MSISDNs to E.164 using country context and validation rules.
acceptance: Known valid/invalid examples pass automated tests.

requirement: Store MSISDN encrypted at application level.
acceptance: Database inspection does not reveal plaintext MSISDN.
notes: Encryption is implemented and wired to preview; persistent contact storage is pending.

requirement: Store a deterministic keyed HMAC for exact lookup and deduplication.
acceptance: Same canonical MSISDN matches; HMAC cannot be reversed without key.

requirement: Display only masked MSISDN to ordinary users.
acceptance: UI and standard exports show configured masking.

requirement: Restrict plaintext decryption to the minimum sending/export services and authorised workflows.
acceptance: Permission and service-role tests pass.

requirement: Store country, state and LGA using controlled reference data.
acceptance: Invalid state/LGA relationship is rejected or quarantined.

requirement: Support unknown/not-provided geography without inventing values.
acceptance: Null/unknown remains distinguishable from invalid.

requirement: Store self-declared numeric age and age-recorded timestamp.
acceptance: Record preserves the exact declared value and collection time.

requirement: Calculate estimated current age using configured approximation rules.
acceptance: Boundary tests for birthdays/partial dates are documented.

requirement: Record age source, verification flag and last-confirmed date.
acceptance: Segment builder can filter by confidence/staleness.

requirement: Never overwrite the original reported age without retaining history.
acceptance: Attribute history shows old/new values and source.

requirement: Support configurable age-data staleness bands.
acceptance: Segment count changes correctly when threshold changes.

requirement: Store gender only when provided under an approved data purpose.
acceptance: Unknown/not-provided is supported; no inference occurs.

requirement: Support approved optional attributes such as language and interest category.
acceptance: Attribute catalogue controls type, values and permitted use.

requirement: Record attribute source, collected-at time and confidence.
acceptance: Every segmentation attribute has lineage.

requirement: Support contact active, inactive, invalid, deceased/closed and possible-recycled-number states.
acceptance: Ineligible states are excluded by policy.

requirement: Maintain source-system identifiers and import provenance.
acceptance: Contact can be traced back to source batch/record.

requirement: Merge duplicate contacts through an approved, reversible process.
acceptance: Merge preserves consent and event lineage and creates audit evidence.

requirement: Prevent ordinary users from searching by partial plaintext MSISDN.
acceptance: Only exact authorised lookup or masked search is allowed.

requirement: Support data correction while preserving history.
acceptance: Correction event identifies source, reason and actor.

requirement: Support at least 10 million canonical contacts without schema redesign.
acceptance: Scale test meets NFR targets.

requirement: Support CSV and XLSX imports through an internal controlled workflow.
acceptance: Valid template imports successfully.

requirement: Provide downloadable versioned import templates.
acceptance: Template version is recorded on import.

requirement: Support configurable column mapping and saved mappings per source.
acceptance: Repeat source can reuse approved mapping.

requirement: Validate file type, extension, MIME signature, size and malware status.
acceptance: Invalid or disguised file is rejected/quarantined.

requirement: Protect against CSV formula injection in previews and exports.
acceptance: Cells beginning with dangerous formula prefixes are neutralised.
notes: Import preview is safe; export formula protection is pending.

requirement: Stream or chunk large files rather than load entire content into memory.
acceptance: Million-row test stays within memory limit.

requirement: Create an immutable import-batch record with checksum, uploader and time.
acceptance: Identical/replayed file is detectable.

requirement: Validate required fields and controlled values.
acceptance: Row-level reason codes are produced.

requirement: Normalise MSISDN using configured default country only where explicit.
acceptance: Ambiguous numbers are quarantined, not guessed.

requirement: Detect duplicate rows within the file.
acceptance: Duplicate count and retained row policy are reported.
notes: Preview deduplication is in-memory and capped; durable database deduplication is pending.

requirement: Detect contacts already present in the repository.
acceptance: Insert/update/no-change counts reconcile to file total.

requirement: Support configurable update policy: fill-null, newest-source, trusted-source or manual conflict.
acceptance: Conflicting attributes follow selected policy.
notes: Fill-null, newest-source, trusted-source and manual-conflict policies are implemented. Manual conflicts support governed single and atomic batch decisions with optimistic versions.

requirement: Never silently broaden existing consent based on a profile import.
acceptance: Consent changes require consent-specific data and evidence.

requirement: Provide import preview and estimated effects before commit.
acceptance: Operator can cancel before data mutation.

requirement: Use database bulk-load techniques and bounded transactions.
acceptance: Large import meets throughput target and can recover from failure.

requirement: Provide row-level error export with masked identifiers.
acceptance: Operator can correct only failed rows.

requirement: Reconcile uploaded, accepted, rejected, duplicate, inserted, updated and unchanged counts.
acceptance: Counts sum exactly to source rows.
notes: Uploaded, valid, invalid, duplicate, suppressed, inserted and updated totals are reconciled and can be closed with immutable evidence after conflicts resolve. A distinct unchanged-contact count is still outstanding.

requirement: Support rollback of an unconsumed erroneous import where legally/operationally safe.
acceptance: Rollback preserves audit and does not delete subsequent independent changes.

requirement: Block campaign use of a batch until required consent review is approved.
acceptance: Unapproved batch cannot create an audience snapshot.

requirement: Support encrypted import file retention or prompt deletion according to policy.
acceptance: Retention job and audit evidence are verified.

requirement: Represent consent as a separate grant, not a Boolean contact field.
acceptance: One contact can hold multiple scopes independently.

requirement: Scope consent to organisation/controller, purpose and channel.
acceptance: Eligibility query requires all configured scope dimensions.

requirement: Record grant time, source, wording version and evidence reference.
acceptance: Consent audit view is complete.

requirement: Support active, pending-verification, expired, withdrawn, revoked and superseded states.
acceptance: Only eligible states are selectable.

requirement: Support effective-from and expiry timestamps.
acceptance: Future and expired grants are handled correctly.

requirement: Record consent withdrawal with source, time and scope.
acceptance: Withdrawal affects eligibility immediately.

requirement: Treat withdrawal as higher priority than an older grant.
acceptance: Event-order tests pass.

requirement: Support a new valid grant after withdrawal only with new evidence and timestamp.
acceptance: Old grant is not reactivated.

requirement: Maintain append-only consent-event history.
acceptance: Current state can be reconstructed from events.

requirement: Support global, organisation, purpose and channel suppression scopes.
acceptance: Precedence tests produce expected exclusion.

requirement: Create suppression automatically from recognised STOP replies after confirmation policy.
acceptance: Inbound STOP creates effective suppression and audit event.
notes: Signed inbound gateway replies are resolved through the authoritative campaign-recipient relationship; exact recognised STOP commands create an immediate idempotent global suppression.

requirement: Support configured STOP synonyms and language variants.
acceptance: Test messages match exact/normalised rules without overmatching ordinary text.
notes: Exact opt-out commands and language variants are governed through versioned effective-dated policy records with maker-checker submission and approval; inbound processing resolves the active policy at execution time.

requirement: Allow manual suppression with reason and authority.
acceptance: Manual action is audited and immediately effective.

requirement: Retain minimised suppression identifiers to prevent re-import contact.
acceptance: Deleted profile remains suppressed by HMAC where policy requires.

requirement: Support invalid-number and possible-recycled-number suppression.
acceptance: Repeated hard failures trigger configured review/suppression.

requirement: Run eligibility at segment estimate, snapshot creation and immediately before dispatch.
acceptance: Withdrawal after snapshot but before send is excluded.

requirement: Prevent consent review approval from overwriting individual withdrawal.
acceptance: Individual preference always wins.

requirement: Expose the exact exclusion reason for authorised operations users.
acceptance: Sample excluded contact displays one or more reason codes.

requirement: Support configurable consent-expiry and renewal policies.
acceptance: Policy version is recorded with snapshot.

requirement: Provide consent and suppression audit/export for authorised privacy workflows.
acceptance: Export is complete, secured and logged.

requirement: Provide a visual segment builder requiring no SQL access.
acceptance: Authorised operator builds a cohort through UI.

requirement: Support equality, inclusion, exclusion, range, null and recency operators.
acceptance: Each operator has unit and integration tests.

requirement: Support filters for country, state, LGA, age, gender, language, interests, source and consent attributes.
acceptance: Approved fields appear according to attribute catalogue.

requirement: Support exact age range such as 18 through 35 using self-declared/estimated age policy.
acceptance: Boundary records at 17,18,35,36 behave correctly.

requirement: Display the age calculation method, source recency and confidence.
acceptance: Operator sees whether age is reported or estimated.

requirement: Allow exclusion of age data older than a configurable period.
acceptance: Stale records are counted separately.

requirement: Require active channel/purpose/organisation consent in the eligibility policy.
acceptance: Demographic match alone never becomes final eligibility.

requirement: Apply suppression, contact status and frequency caps to final eligibility.
acceptance: Count waterfall reconciles.
notes: Cohort compilation applies active suppression, contact status and governed frequency caps before snapshot materialisation.

requirement: Support AND/OR groups with a maximum configurable complexity.
acceptance: Complex rules validate and execute without injection.

requirement: Provide a human-readable summary of the segment logic.
acceptance: Summary accurately represents nested rules.

requirement: Estimate matching counts without exposing raw MSISDNs.
acceptance: Count result is returned within NFR target.

requirement: Display a count waterfall: demographic, consent, expiry, suppression, cap and final eligible.
acceptance: Totals reconcile with snapshot.

requirement: Save, version, clone, retire and compare segment definitions.
acceptance: Historical campaign references remain immutable.
notes: Saved segments support create, version, clone, archive and version comparison. Clones receive independent identifiers and histories while historical versions remain immutable.

requirement: Restrict segment fields based on user permission and data-use policy.
acceptance: Unauthorised sensitive field is absent or blocked.
notes: Sensitive governed filter definitions require the configured permission during HTTP validation, compilation and snapshot creation; direct code submission cannot bypass hidden UI fields.

requirement: Create an immutable audience snapshot with hash and policy versions.
acceptance: Membership cannot be altered after freeze.
notes: Immutable snapshot membership, deterministic hash and policy/configuration versions are enforced.

requirement: Store snapshot creation time, rule version and initiating user.
acceptance: Audit view is complete.
notes: Snapshots and materialisation jobs preserve creation time, initiating user, definition version, consent policy version and configuration version.

requirement: Perform final live suppression/consent check before each send.
acceptance: Post-snapshot opt-out is excluded.

requirement: Support cohort overlap analysis without exporting identities.
acceptance: System returns counts for intersection and difference.
notes: Identity-free audience snapshot overlap returns intersection, left-only, right-only and union counts without exporting contact identifiers.

requirement: Prevent tiny cohort reporting below configurable privacy threshold.
acceptance: Dashboard groups/suppresses small slices.

requirement: Support asynchronous snapshot creation for multi-million audiences with progress and resumability.
acceptance: Large job can resume without duplicate membership.
notes: Durable asynchronous multi-million audience materialisation uses bounded pages, fenced leases, persistent cursors, rolling hashes, progress, retries, cancellation evidence and restart-safe continuation without duplicate membership.

requirement: Create campaigns linked to one internal organisation and consent-review basis.
acceptance: Release is blocked if linkage is missing/invalid.

requirement: Store campaign name, purpose, category, owner, requested window and completion deadline.
acceptance: Required data is validated.

requirement: Support draft, review, approved, scheduled, dispatching, paused, completed, exception, cancelled and expired states.
acceptance: Invalid transitions are rejected.

requirement: Attach exactly one immutable audience snapshot to an approved release version.
acceptance: Approved campaign cannot switch snapshot silently.
notes: Campaign release binds an immutable snapshot and material changes invalidate approvals.

requirement: Compose text, image-caption, video, document and supported provider message types.
acceptance: Capability validation blocks unsupported combination.

requirement: Store media in object storage with checksum, type, size and scan status.
acceptance: Tampered/quarantined asset cannot be used.

requirement: Support approved personalisation variables with typed values and fallback.
acceptance: Missing variable follows configured fail/fallback rule.

requirement: Preview message using representative test records with masked data.
acceptance: Preview renders all variables.

requirement: Send controlled test messages only to approved test numbers.
acceptance: Production cohort is never used for test send.

requirement: Version message text, media, variables and links.
acceptance: Any material edit creates new version.

requirement: Hash the approved message version and include it in campaign release.
acceptance: Dispatch job references exact immutable version.

requirement: Require reapproval after material message, media, link, audience, sender or schedule change.
acceptance: Prior approval is invalidated automatically.
notes: Material audience, message, entitlement, transport and schedule changes are explicit, MFA-protected, optimistically versioned, recorded append-only and automatically regress the campaign to the required approval stage.

requirement: Support optional reply/STOP instruction policy by campaign type.
acceptance: Required instruction validation is enforced.

requirement: Support tracked links using a controlled redirect domain and signed identifiers.
acceptance: Link does not expose contact/MSISDN and click is attributable to campaign recipient token.

requirement: Validate destination URLs against configured safety rules.
acceptance: Disallowed scheme/domain is blocked or requires approval.

requirement: Schedule campaigns in a declared timezone and persist UTC.
acceptance: DST and timezone tests produce correct dispatch time.

requirement: Support quiet hours and jurisdiction/organisation sending windows.
acceptance: Jobs outside window remain held.

requirement: Support start, deadline and latest-admission time.
acceptance: Campaign acceptance calculation is recorded.

requirement: Allow pause, resume and cancel with reason and authority.
acceptance: State change affects undispatched jobs and is audited.

requirement: Display impact before cancel or audience invalidation.
acceptance: Operator sees sent, in-flight and remaining counts.

requirement: Prevent deletion of campaigns with audit or delivery history.
acceptance: Only archive/retire is allowed.

requirement: Support campaign tags and internal notes with visibility controls.
acceptance: Notes do not leak into client report.

requirement: Support cloning while generating new IDs and requiring fresh approvals.
acceptance: Clone cannot reuse old entitlement or frozen snapshot.

requirement: Support campaign archiving according to retention policy.
acceptance: Archived campaign remains reportable at approved level.

requirement: Implement configurable approval stages by campaign risk/size/category.
acceptance: Workflow engine selects correct stages.

requirement: Require consent review approval before audience finalisation.
acceptance: Blocked transition is verified.

requirement: Require message/content approval before scheduling.
acceptance: Unapproved version cannot dispatch.

requirement: Require final campaign release approval by an authorised user.
acceptance: Only permitted role can release.

requirement: Enforce maker-checker based on configuration and campaign threshold.
acceptance: Creator cannot self-approve where prohibited.

requirement: Record approval decision, actor, time, comments and object version.
acceptance: Approval evidence is immutable.

requirement: Invalidate approval when approved data changes.
acceptance: Change triggers clear status regression.
notes: Any material approved-data replacement clears final approval; message, audience or entitlement changes also clear commercial approval as appropriate and require a new approval path.

requirement: Record quote, invoice, payment and commercial-approval references without requiring online payment.
acceptance: Finance status is visible and auditable.
notes: Commercial evidence is recorded offline without requiring a public wallet or online payment flow; approval requires independent finance review and verified payment evidence.

requirement: Optionally block release until payment/commercial approval.
acceptance: Policy switch is effective-dated.
notes: Campaign commercial progression now resolves an approved campaign-specific commercial record and enforces the authorised recipient ceiling before COMMERCIAL_APPROVED.

requirement: Create a campaign entitlement defining maximum unique recipients and messages per recipient.
acceptance: Attempt to exceed entitlement is rejected.

requirement: Tie entitlement to organisation, campaign, snapshot and message version.
acceptance: Entitlement cannot be reused elsewhere.

requirement: Consume/reserve entitlement atomically with recipient ledger creation.
acceptance: Concurrent release cannot over-allocate.

requirement: Require a new approved entitlement for an additional message or resend outside policy.
acceptance: Second campaign/message is blocked without approval.

requirement: Support emergency stop by authorised role without deleting evidence.
acceptance: Dispatch halts and audit/alerts are generated.

requirement: Support approved exception workflow with reason, expiry and second approval.
acceptance: Exception is visible in report/audit according to policy.

requirement: Maintain an inventory of genuine sender MSISDNs and WhatsApp account metadata.
acceptance: Every active session maps to one controlled sender record.

requirement: Store sender MSISDN encrypted and display masked by default.
acceptance: UI/log inspection shows no ordinary plaintext.

requirement: Record ownership, registration country, profile/display name, recovery information reference and lifecycle status.
acceptance: Operational record is complete without exposing secrets.

requirement: Support logical sender pools that map to one or more actual sender accounts.
acceptance: Operator selects pool; recipient ledger records actual sender.
notes: Logical sender pools map to governed concrete sessions. Version 0.8.19 adds immutable multi-pool campaign routing plans, deterministic shard/pool allocation evidence and atomic pool-capacity reservations.

requirement: Clearly disclose that logical sender is not an alphanumeric WhatsApp sender ID.
acceptance: UI/help text and reports use accurate wording.

requirement: Support ready, connecting, disconnected, paused, draining, restricted, retired and quarantined sender states.
acceptance: Scheduler uses only eligible states.
notes: Governed sender lifecycle includes quarantine; quarantined/restricted/retired sessions are excluded from allocation and runtime heartbeats cannot silently re-enable them.

requirement: Allow each session to have exactly one active worker lease.
acceptance: Concurrent lease acquisition fails deterministically.

requirement: Renew leases through heartbeat and expire stale leases safely.
acceptance: Dead worker becomes unavailable after threshold.

requirement: Require manual or controlled recovery before another worker activates an uncertain live session.
acceptance: Split-brain test does not run same session twice.

requirement: Record worker public/stable IP and infrastructure identity.
acceptance: Operations can trace sessions to nodes.

requirement: Allow several sessions per VPS only within configured tested resource limits.
acceptance: Admission control blocks excess placement.

requirement: Support per-session proxy settings only for approved stable routing.
acceptance: Configuration is encrypted, audited and tested.

requirement: Maintain per-sender configured and measured safe throughput.
acceptance: Capacity view separates configured cap from observed rate.
notes: Configured safe throughput and runtime pacing are enforced. Observed-rate calibration and live engine-specific capacity evidence still require genuine OpenWA sessions.

requirement: Maintain per-sender hourly/daily safety limits and cooldown.
acceptance: Scheduler stops allocation at limit.
notes: Effective-dated maker-checker pacing policies govern per-session minimum/maximum delay, jitter, hourly and daily submission allowances, cooldown and active-campaign limits. The campaign worker enforces durable counters before provider submission.

requirement: Maintain per-sender failure, disconnect and delivery-health thresholds.
acceptance: Threshold breach pauses or drains sender.
notes: Failure, disconnect and health thresholds are represented and influence allocation/throttling; fully automatic threshold-driven quarantine requires live telemetry calibration.

requirement: Prevent automatic allocation to a newly paired sender until readiness checks pass.
acceptance: Readiness test status is required.

requirement: Support sender reservation for a campaign or organisation.
acceptance: Conflicting reservation is rejected.

requirement: Support one-active-campaign-per-sender policy as configurable default.
acceptance: Interleaving is blocked unless explicitly enabled/tested.

requirement: Provide pairing/QR access only to technical administrators with step-up authentication.
acceptance: Unauthorised role cannot view pairing data.

requirement: Never log session tokens, QR payloads or credentials.
acceptance: Secret scanning/log tests pass.

requirement: Support controlled retirement and secure session-state deletion.
acceptance: Retired sender cannot receive jobs and deletion is evidenced.

requirement: Maintain warm standby workers/senders without counting them as guaranteed capacity until health-checked.
acceptance: Capacity calculation includes only ready capacity.

requirement: Create one authoritative campaign-recipient record per unique campaign, contact and message version.
acceptance: Database unique constraint blocks duplicates.

requirement: Use a deterministic idempotency key for every recipient obligation.
acceptance: Replayed release/job maps to the same record.

requirement: Create entitlement reservation, recipient record and outbox event atomically.
acceptance: Failure cannot leave untracked queue work or missing queue work.

requirement: Publish execution jobs from a transactional outbox.
acceptance: Outbox publisher can resume after crash.

requirement: Use Redis/BullMQ or equivalent only as execution queue, not source of truth.
acceptance: Queue can be rebuilt from PostgreSQL state.

requirement: Partition large campaigns into bounded dispatch shards.
acceptance: Five-million-recipient campaign does not create one unmanageable transaction/job.

requirement: Claim jobs atomically with lease/visibility timeout.
acceptance: Two workers cannot process the same job concurrently.

requirement: Allocate jobs only to ready sender sessions with available capacity.
acceptance: Ineligible sender receives no job.

requirement: Respect campaign schedule, quiet hours, deadline and pause state at dispatch time.
acceptance: Held jobs remain unsent.

requirement: Perform a final consent, suppression and contact-status check before submission.
acceptance: Late withdrawal is excluded.

requirement: Apply per-sender rate and in-flight limits.
